notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard federation MOM save conditionals. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, adapter-selected logical-time values, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It verifies HLAfederation save-name and save-time state across pending save, admission, and completion without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.
